_read_me: Spoilers. The GM console loads this for gm and admin sign-ins only. Edit the lines freely. It is a list, not a schedule: since 23 Sep the hints have no times against them and the game master gives one when the room needs one. Rewritten 23 Sep for the 20-minutes-fast rewrite (CHANGES_FOR_CLAUDE_CODE.md §6.2, ESCAPE_ROOM_PLAN.md §4a): the first three lines are the new ones, `motive` and `method` stay as the optional two, and `merge` is a sixth, optional entry — it is a stage direction for the actor, not a hint. Never name Natalie before they have connected the evidence. Anything with "optional": true sits under 'If they are still stuck' at the bottom of the list.

hints.title: The trap
hints.line: They're saying Jasmine lied about when she left.

hints.title: The clock
hints.line: They're asking whether the oven clock in that kitchen picture matches the camera's time.

hints.title: The warrant
hints.line: They need four things on that warrant: who, the minute, why, and how.

hints.title: Motive
hints.line: Why would tonight matter more than tomorrow morning?

hints.title: Method
hints.line: Why are there two cakes, and why is one labelled NUT FREE?

hints.title: Bring them together
hints.line: Everyone, to the desk. They want one story, not two.

reset: Walnut cake on the table, one slice cut, that slice half-eaten on Kai's plate. Brown-dot allergen card beside the box.
Darren's receipt on the counter. Fridge card on the fridge.
EpiPen case open and empty on the kitchen shelf.
Notebook out; will and solicitor's letter back in the drawer.
Desk: four statements, contact sheet, large print of Still 5, bin photos A and B, four suspect cards. Wipe the Real time column of the board.
Fresh warrant and pen in the box. Close it and scramble the lock — never leave it reading 1002.
Kai in place. Lights, music, smoke.
